entries.4a4af8a63aeb5734: Consolidated subsidiary Nextcare Innovation Co., Ltd. sells nursing care products and welfare equipment, such as wheelchairs, silver carts and walkers, by mail order through the internet and other channels. It purchases products from the company and partner factories and sells them directly to users. Revenue from external customers was ¥696 million in the fiscal year ended February 2026.

entries.740e28da52c82840: Nursing Care Products and Welfare Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business
entries.85e65def4a314254: Consolidated subsidiaries Kowa Raifuzeshon Co., Ltd. and Person Care Co., Ltd. operate the welfare equipment rental business under the Long-Term Care Insurance Act. Based on the physical and mental condition, wishes and living environment of persons requiring nursing care or support, they rent out nursing care products and welfare equipment to support independent daily living. Revenue from external customers was ¥279 million in the fiscal year ended February 2026.
entries.86f347aca367f8f4: Mass Retailers such as Home Centers, Discount Stores and Supermarkets
entries.922464afde29515a: The company is headquartered in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture, and manufactures and sells nursing care products and welfare equipment, provides nursing care services, and operates e-commerce. The company and its five consolidated subsidiaries, six companies in total, make up the group. As of February 28, 2026, the number of employees was 211. The company is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,394 million, and revenue from external customers by segment was ¥5,418 million for the Nursing Care Products and Welfare Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business, ¥279 million for the Nursing Care Services Business and ¥696 million for the EC Business. A major customer is Panasonic Age-Free Co., Ltd.
entries.9f723f0d8a69788a: Its main products are welfare equipment for walking assistance, such as silver carts, walkers and canes, and it also handles daily-living support products for bathing, toileting and medication support. Silver carts and walkers are mainly manufactured at Dongguan Kowa Household Products Co., Ltd., the production base in Dongguan, China, while canes and other welfare equipment are procured from contracted factories and suppliers in Japan and overseas. Sales channels include the chain store channel for mass retailers through agents (wholesalers), the nursing care channel for nursing care service providers, and the OEM channel that responds to orders from customers, among others. Revenue from external customers was ¥5,418 million in the fiscal year ended February 2026.
